messages:
Avery (Product): Quick UX flag from today's usability test — the network probe timeline in the Private setup wizard feels cramped and noisy :confused:
Mark (PM): 2 quick q's — which screen exactly? screenshot?
Avery (Product): The 'Network checks' step where we show port/egress/ssh probes. The three rows with status dots + timestamps look visually heavy when all show 'waiting' for >10s. Users thought it was stuck. Screenshot pasted: https://redwood/mock/screen123
Jun (Design): Yep saw that. Also the microcopy under each probe is long and gets truncated on narrow screens. Thinking: collapse long-running probes into a single collapsed row with a summary spinner + small facepile of probe names.
Priya (Eng): From infra side, we emit probe events every 2s while probing. We can coalesce UI updates to reduce flicker. Backend can emit summary updates too.
Sam (Frontend): Implementation note: if we collapse, we still need to show per-probe logs on expand. Proposed interaction: collapsed row shows "3 checks running · 8s" and button "View details" which expands an accordion.
Avery (Product): Also accessibility nit — VoiceOver reads each status update one-by-one. For long probes it's noisy. Can we use an aria-live="polite" summary update and not spam screen readers? @AccessibilityBot any guidance?
AccessibilityBot: Suggestion: use aria-live="polite" on the summary element and role="status" with updates throttled to 1s. Provide link: https://a11y.example/guidelines#live-regions
Mark (PM): Copy tweaks: change "Attempting SSH" -> "Checking SSH access" and "Timed out" -> "No response from host" (less technical). Also add a help link per-row: "What does this mean?" linking to KB.
Jun (Design): Agree on copy. For the collapsed state, microcopy should read: "Probes running — results will appear here. If checks fail, click 'View details' to see troubleshooting steps."
Priya (Eng): Can backend include a per-probe troubleshooting code like `probe_code: SSH_EGRESS_BLOCKED` so UI can deep-link KB sections? We can add a small code badge to collapsed details.
Sam (Frontend): UI sketch: 1) Collapsed summary row 2) Lightweight spinner + elapsed timer 3) "View details" that reveals a list with small badges and a CTA button "Open KB". I'll mock in Figma and drop a link.
Avery (Product): Small animation request: when a probe finishes, animate the status dot from spinner -> check in 250ms to make it feel alive. Avoid multiple reflows.
Priya (Eng): We'll add an event type `probe_summary` every 3s and a `probe_complete` event immediate for final transitions. That should let frontend animate without polling.
Jun (Design): Contrast thing — the timestamp + muted text is too low contrast on Safari on our test laptop. Bump to 60% gray and ensure token sizes don't drop below 12px.
AccessibilityBot: Reminder: color alone shouldn't convey status. Ensure icons have accessible labels and focus states.
Mark (PM): Action items: Sam to mock, Jun to adjust copy & contrast, Priya to add `probe_summary` event, AccessibilityBot notes implemented, Avery will update KB IDs. Delivery ETA: next Tues?
Sam (Frontend): Ack — I'll post Figma link in this thread by EOD Fri.
Priya (Eng): I'll create a feature branch and add a small schema for `probe_summary` — pinging @CI-Bot for a quick integration test.
CI-Bot: CI pipeline queued for branch `probe-summary-ui` — build #456 in progress.
Avery (Product): Thanks all — this should cut down confusion from customers who think the wizard is stuck. Small follow-up: add a one-line helper above the probes: "These checks take up to 30s depending on your network." demos helped set expectations.
Mark (PM): Nice. If we can get that copy + collapsed interaction shipped next week it's a win. :rocket:
